entities.name: Query protein (417 aa)
observations: 417-aa sequence strongly matches reviewed pyrophosphate–fructose-6-phosphate 1-phosphotransferase Q609I3 (74.5% identity, 99.0% query coverage; E=6.87e-227).
Likely catalyzes fructose-6-phosphate + pyrophosphate ⇌ fructose-1,6-bisphosphate + phosphate; EC 2.7.1.90, Rhea RHEA:13613, transferred by strong homology rather than query-specific experiment.
PFK domain PF00365 detected at residues 9–322.
Predicted molecular mass 45.29 kDa, pI 8.93, instability index 39.0; computational sequence properties only.
Reference homolog annotations indicate cytoplasmic localization and Mg2+ cofactor; these remain homology-based for the query.
